messages:
lucy (AE): FYI: ArgentBank POC started load test and hit a mix of 429s and a few 504s. they want a single channel for tech updates and SSQ follow-ups. can we swarm?

omar (SE): on it. sample req id: argent_20260505_12, window 14:10-14:25 ET. what was their traffic pattern?

lucy (AE): stepped ramp 0->150rps in 90s, context ~1800 tokens average.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy: model-runtime v3.1 -> pilot-group at 2026-05-05T13:55:02Z.

dak (SRE): logs show gateway 429s during ramp, and 504s where worker hung waiting on KV fetch. likely cache cold plus heavy max_tokens.

viktor (Runtime Eng): suggest temporary measures: 1) reduce max_tokens to 512 2) enable aggressive KV prefetch for this key 3) bump per-key burst cap to 220rps. can do quick config push.

priya (SecOps): SSQ note: ArgentBank asked about encryption rotation and audit logs export. i'll prepare the SSQ packet; need confirmation if POC uses hosted API or Dedicated.

omar (SE): telemetry says hosted with key argent-test-77. if they need sustained load we'll propose Dedicated.

lucy (AE): told them to run a second controlled ramp at 14:45 with reduced tokens.

dak (SRE): applying burst bump and enabling KV prefetch on pilot pool now, will monitor.

deploy-bot: Alert: KV prefetch latency improved on pilot-group at 2026-05-05T14:40:10Z.

ovar (typo) -> viktor (Runtime Eng): patched prefix cache and lowered per-request retention.

omar (SE): second ramp started 14:45. initial metrics: 429s dropped to near zero, 504s gone.

lucy (AE): ArgentBank security requested SSQ by EOD and a Dedicated pricing for 4-week trial. priya, can you send SSQ? sales-ops needs pricing.

priya (SecOps): SSQ draft ready, attaching link internally. will export after legal sign-off.

dak (SRE): will scale down temporary warm workers at 18:00 ET unless asked to keep. documenting runbook steps.

lucy (AE): thanks team. lessons learned: request expected peak rps & context size before POC. will add to POC checklist. closing thread if no objections. :white_check_mark:
